def: Recovering the grid of rows, columns, spans and header cells of a table from its image or word boxes.
The arrangement of a table's cells in rows and columns, including merged cells and which cells are headers.
A table cell that covers more than one column, such as a heading over two sub-columns, which Markdown tables cannot express.
The harmonic mean of precision and recall over table cells, counting a cell as correct only if its position, spans and text all match.
Tree-edit-distance-based similarity, a table metric that compares predicted and true tables as HTML trees and gives partial credit for small structural damage.
Finding a form's labels and their values and returning them as named fields.
One named item to be extracted from a document, with a type and rules, such as an invoice total or a date of birth.
A specification of the fields an extraction must produce, with their types, which are required and the rules that relate them.
Checking relationships between extracted values, such as net plus tax equalling gross, to catch errors that each field passes alone.
The share of documents accepted automatically without a person reviewing them.
The share of automatically accepted documents that contain a wrong value, measured by auditing a random sample of them.
Using the check digits built into identifiers such as IBANs and card numbers to detect a misread character.
